_about: Programs for students of a given gender, across fields: women in medicine, law, cybersecurity, science, supply chain, and federal law enforcement; men in nursing; LGBTQ+ women and non-binary people in tech. Shown only to students who say their gender (or skip identity questions, labeled to check eligibility). Found by web search 2026-11-16.

resources.name: American Medical Women's Association (premedical)
resources.summary: National network for women in medicine. Its premedical division is open to any student before medical school, with mentoring, conference fee waivers, and premedical awards.

contact.how: Join the premedical division, or start or join a campus branch.

resources.name: American Association for Men in Nursing
resources.summary: Professional association that supports men in nursing, with student chapters, scholarships for student members, and an annual conference. Membership is open to nursing students of any gender.

contact.how: Join as a student member; NSNA members get a discount.

resources.name: Ms. JD pre-law programs
resources.summary: Free pre-law programs from a nonprofit for women in law: step-by-step guidance through the law school application and a twice-yearly application conference.

contact.how: Sign up for the free pre-law program on the site.

resources.name: Women in CyberSecurity (WiCyS)
resources.summary: Community for women in cybersecurity. Student members can apply for conference scholarships (applications usually open in the fall) and training scholarships.

contact.how: Become a student member, then apply for the conference scholarship.

resources.name: Association for Women in Science (AWIS)
resources.summary: Professional network for women in STEM with scholarships, career resources, and mentoring. Many universities cover student membership; check before paying.

contact.how: Join as a student member with your school email.

resources.name: AWESOME Excellence in Education Scholarship
resources.summary: A $5,000 award for women in full-time supply chain programs, with a trip to the AWESOME Symposium and CSCMP EDGE and ongoing mentoring. Schools nominate candidates.

contact.how: Ask your supply chain department whether it nominates students.

verification.note: Confirmed by search; automated check was refused (bot wall).

resources.name: Women in Federal Law Enforcement (WIFLE) Scholarship
resources.summary: Scholarship for students preparing for federal law enforcement careers, open after at least one year of college. An essay is required.

contact.how: Apply on the WIFLE Foundation site in spring.

resources.name: Lesbians Who Tech
resources.summary: Community of LGBTQ+ women, trans, and non-binary people in tech, with events, a job board, and the Edie Windsor coding scholarship.

contact.how: Join the community and look for local events.
